[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] commanded an '''''Acclamator''-class assault ship''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], sent to reinforce [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] in the [[Qiilura system/Legends|Qiilura system]]. En route, Wolffe's [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] was temporarily redirected to [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|deliver]] relief supplies to the [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]-stricken [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]].
